summary: Your feelings run deep and they don't do casual. You bond all the way, and you brace for loss before there's a reason. For you, closeness and danger learned to feel like the same thing.
body: Your feelings run deep and they don't do casual. You bond all the way, and you brace for loss before there's a reason. For you, closeness and danger learned to feel like the same thing. This can make love, control, and loss feel tangled until trust has time to prove itself. You may test the people closest to you, or hold on so tight you strangle the thing you're protecting. You feel everything at full volume. That's a power you haven't aimed yet, and the work is letting closeness feel safe instead of like something to manage.
gift: At your best: fiercely loyal, emotionally fearless, the one who goes where others won't.
shadow: The trap: jealousy, testing, and control wearing love's clothes.
integration: Let your instincts speak, then let the present moment answer. Trust becomes possible when protection includes choice.
do: Name the fear instead of acting on it
